articles.headline: ASML beats expectations and warns demand for advanced chip tools will outstrip capacity
articles.summary: ASML said Q3 profits beat expectations, raised Q4 sales guidance, and noted customer interest extending through 2030. For businesses, this points to sustained AI infrastructure demand and continued pressure on semiconductor supply chains and capital spending.

articles.headline: Europe’s AI Act keeps pressure on companies over compliance and cybersecurity
articles.summary: The EU AI Act imposes requirements on data quality, human oversight, and cybersecurity, with non-compliance potentially leading to forced changes and fines of up to 3% of annual turnover. That makes AI governance and documentation a direct operational risk for firms deploying AI in Europe.

articles.headline: Chinese memory-chip advances rattle markets and pressure Asian semiconductor stocks
articles.summary: Reports that CXMT is advancing next-generation DRAM products triggered a selloff in memory and chip stocks, with investors reassessing pricing power and competition. For buyers of servers, PCs, and cloud infrastructure, this signals potential volatility in memory pricing and supplier strategy.
